versions.description_html:
Learn what a Fabric SQL Database is, how it compares to Azure SQL, how mirroring works, and how it powers your analytics without extra pipelines.

Fabric and SQL sound like two different things, but Microsoft built them into one. It's called a SQL database in Fabric, and underneath it runs the same engine that powers Azure SQL Database.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What a Fabric SQL Database Really Is
  • Why It Feels Like Azure SQL, and Where It Doesn't
  • The Copy That Makes Itself
  • One Database, Two Jobs
  • How It Uses Your Fabric Capacity
  • Where It Fits, and Where It Stops
  • The Short Recap, and One Question for You

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM

  • Query Microsoft Fabric in Plain English with Copilot Studio
  • Why SharePoint Is Not a Database for Power Apps
  • More Data & Fabric episodes on M365.FM
